item.title: Men, Women, and Obvious Truths We’re Not Supposed to Acknowledge
item.description: Men, Women, and Obvious Truths We’re Not Supposed to Acknowledge Am I sexist? I think there are differences between men and women -- traits beyond obvious physical ones. But when I was young, feminist leaders said there were no differences. The only reason men ran most things was sexism. There was plenty of that.
